task.title: The sandbox gateway defaults its log folder to <deployment>/logs, not the folder the worker and the console use
task.body:
## Problem

`readGatewayConfig` sets `logsDir: resolve(config.deployment, env.PI_LOGS_DIR ?? "logs")` (gateway/src/config.mjs:38).
With `PI_LOGS_DIR` unset in the deployment `.env`, the gateway writes into `<deployment>/logs`:
- its console audit rows (`sandbox-browser-*`, `sandbox-watch-*`), through `makeConsoleAudit`
  (gateway/src/audit.mjs:7), into `<deployment>/logs/console-audit/`;
- its crash journal, `<deployment>/logs/sandbox-gateway-active/` (gateway/src/audit.mjs:8).

The worker and the console default to `~/.pi-dispatch/logs` (`defaultLogsDir` and `logsDirPath`,
worker/src/config.mjs:1085 and 1149; the console at admin/src/console/config.mjs:137). A relative `PI_LOGS_DIR`
resolves against the deployment folder in both the gateway and the console, so only the default differs.

`<deployment>/logs` is where the service manager writes `worker.out.log` and `worker.err.log`. docs/backup.md:164-167
lists it as not backed up and says "`PI_LOGS_DIR` must never be pointed at that directory". docs/backup.md:310-311 says
it again.

## Why it matters

With the default:
- The console's Audit page reads `console-audit` under its own folder (admin/src/console/cli.mjs:652), so it never
  shows who opened or watched a sandbox in the browser.
- The worker prunes audit months under its own folder only (`makeConsoleAuditReaper`, worker/src/start.mjs:1493), so
  the gateway's rows are kept forever, whatever `PI_CONSOLE_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` says.
- A backup made by docs/backup.md leaves them out.

The audit trail is split across two folders, and the one the console reads looks complete.

## Change

- The gateway uses the same default as the worker and the console (`logsDirPath`), so with `PI_LOGS_DIR` unset its
  rows land in the console's audit log.
- docs/sandbox-gateway.md says which folder the gateway writes to.
- docs/upgrading.md says what to do with rows already written under `<deployment>/logs/console-audit/`.

## Done when

- With `PI_LOGS_DIR` unset, a browser attach shows on the console's Audit page, and a test pins the gateway's default
  to `logsDirPath`.
- The gateway writes nothing under `<deployment>/logs` unless `PI_LOGS_DIR` points there.
- docs/sandbox-gateway.md names the folder.
